_source: Our own table: the recipes of IV's uranium cycle, package IV-A4 (docs/eras/iv.md, 'Uranium in-situ leach field', 'Fuel fabrication plant' and 'Decisions taken with the raise', decisions 2 and 7). Real processes: acid in-situ recovery of uranium (five-spot wellfields, sulfuric acid with an oxidant, ion exchange of the uranyl; about 55 % of the world's uranium output in 2022-24, World Nuclear Association) and light-water reactor fuel fabrication (UO2 pellets pressed and then sintered in hydrogen at about 2,000 K, Zircaloy-4 cladding tubes cold-pilgered, rods backfilled with helium). The energy figures are GTM 7.5.3's own stages, named in each entry.
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/iv/uranium_cycle.js at every server load (a /reload picks up changes). startup_scripts/grindless/iv/uranium_cycle.js registers the two machines and their recipe types; it does not read this file.

energy: a recipe costs the SUM of the stages it stands for (eu x times of each entry), with no discount, spent at maxEUt like the hot cell and the platinum plant: ceil(energy / maxEUt) ticks at ceil(energy / ticks) EU/t, so it never costs less than its stages (a few EU more at most). 'from' says where the figure comes from: a live recipe (EU/t x ticks), GTM's default blast-furnace stage of a material (mass x temperature / 50 ticks at 120 EU/t, MaterialRecipeHandler) or GTM's small-pipe extrusion of a material (mass ticks at 6 x 7 EU/t below 2,800 K, PipeRecipeHandler). The smoke test reads each one back from the running game.

leaching: one gtceu:in_situ_leaching recipe per vein of veins_leach.json (IV-A1's table of the veins no drill takes), id grindless:in_situ_leaching/<vein id>: the vein sample (never used up) + the resin (a chanced input: its wear, of 10,000) + fluidsIn -> itemsOut (an entry with a chance is a chanced output, of 10,000), with .dimension(dimension). Every recipe has its own sample, so GTM's recipe lookup keeps them all.

fabrication: one gtceu:fuel_fabrication recipe per entry, id grindless:fuel_fabrication/<name>. The programmed circuit picks the step, one circuit each (GTM's lookup keeps one recipe per set of ingredients, and a set inside another can hide it). itemsIn: { id, count, chance? }, chance of 10,000: none or 10,000 = used up, 0 = never used up (needed in the bus), anything between = a chanced input (wear). itemsOut: an entry with a chance below 10,000 is a chanced output of one item. fluidsKept must be in a hatch but are never used up (GTM's notConsumableFluid): the sintering hydrogen goes round inside the furnace.

energy.stage: the ore plant's whole chain for one raw pitchblende (maceration, washing, thermal centrifuge, maceration)
one bore of the HV vein drill
pressing each green pellet: GTM's forming press pressing a powder in a mould
sintering the batch in hydrogen: GTM's blast-furnace stage for uraninite (UO2) at 2,000 K
pilgering one ingot into two thin tubes: GTM's small-pipe extrusion of an alloy of zircaloy's mass
loading the rods and closing the assembly in the helium glovebox: one IV assembler stage

fabrication.name: kroll_zr_sponge
fabrication._why: UIV-A8, line 8: Kroll reduction of hafnium-free zirconium tetrachloride with magnesium; the cake keeps its magnesium chloride until the vacuum distillation of the UIV components line (uiv_components.json).

energy.stage: reducing the tetrachloride under argon in the retort: one IV assembler stage

fabrication.name: u238_flash_target
fabrication._why: UIV-B2, line 32: natural uranium (U-238) cast into the foil-backed target that the r-process decompressor floods with neutrons.

energy.stage: casting the uranium into its tungsten backing in the glovebox: one IV assembler stage
